text:
Maria - New Hire: Hey all — just unboxed my company Mac and trying to enroll in MDM. Stuck on 'Waiting for profile' in System Settings. Also can't enable FileVault, and Docker install wants admin rights. Who do I ping for this? :wave:
Alex C: Welcome Maria! :tada: Ping @Oliver - EngInfra for MDM, and @Rachel (People Ops) for admin access. Quick Q — did you sign in with Okta SSO during setup?
Maria - New Hire: yep used Okta SSO when prompted. Enrollment step completed but profile never appears. System shows "MDM enrollment: pending".
IT Bot: Created ticket SUPPORT-1023 assigned to eng-infra. Someone will take a look within 2 business hours.
Oliver - EngInfra: Hi Maria — can you DM me the Mac serial or paste it here? Also run these quick checks and paste output:```bash
system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial
profiles status -type enrollment
fdesetup status
```
Samir: If it's an Apple Silicon machine, sometimes APNS certs cause a delay. Also FileVault is usually engaged via MDM profile — if the profile's pending you won't be able to enable it manually.
Rachel (People Ops): For admin access requests, we need device serial + manager approval. I can fast-track temporary sudo for installs once we confirm identity. CC your manager here so we have approval on file.
Maria - New Hire: Serial is C02ABCDEFGH1. Here are outputs:```
Serial: C02ABCDEFGH1
profiles: No profiles found.
fdesetup: FileVault is Off.
```
Oliver - EngInfra: OK that helps. Looks like the device didn't get the enrollment profile from Jamf. I've kicked an enrollment refresh from our MDM console for that serial. Try rebooting and then check System Settings -> Profiles after a few minutes.
Oliver - EngInfra: If that doesn't land, run this log gather and paste the last 50 lines:```bash
sudo log show --predicate 'process == "mdmclient"' --last 5m | tail -n 50
```
Samir: For Docker specifically, you can use the Homebrew variant without admin for now:```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
brew install --cask docker
```
Maria - New Hire: Rebooted — still no profile. Running the mdmclient log now and pasting in a sec. Thanks for the brew workaround.
IT Bot: SUPPORT-1023 updated: EngInfra requested MDM enrollment refresh; target response ETA 45m.
Maria - New Hire: pasted log snippet: "mdmclient: failed to fetch configuration: 403 service unavailable"
Oliver - EngInfra: 403 usually means our device certificate hasn't been accepted by Apple DEP for this serial. I'm escalating to Jamf support. In meantime @Rachel can you authorize temporary local admin for Maria? We'll revoke after this is resolved.
Rachel (People Ops): Sure — Maria, please confirm your manager (so we have approval) and I'll provision temporary admin for 8 hours.
Maria - New Hire: Manager is Alex C. Thanks!
Alex C: Yup I approve temporary admin for software installs during onboarding.
Rachel (People Ops): Done — temporary admin created for user maria@redwood.com, expires in 8 hours. Check System Settings -> Users & Groups; you should see "Admin (temporary)".
Maria - New Hire: I see the admin flag now, can install Docker and run dev setup. Also FileVault still off but urgent thing is getting dev env up. Thanks everyone.
Oliver - EngInfra: I'll keep pushing Jamf. Once enrollment completes we'll push the FileVault profile and revoke the temporary admin. I'll update ticket SUPPORT-1023.
Maria - New Hire: Awesome, appreciate it! :heart:
IT Bot: SUPPORT-1023 resolved by eng-infra; follow-up: Jamf enrollment corrected (DEP issue) — profile applied and FileVault profile pushed. Admin rights revoked. If anything else, reply here or reopen the ticket.
Maria - New Hire: All good — FileVault is on and Docker installed. Thanks team! :rocket:
